title: Germany news: Merz's coalition agrees on electricity tax cut
summary: The coalition government has agreed on an electricity tax cut for households amid energy shocks from the war in Iran. Meanwhile, the BSW party has failed to push for a recount of the 2025 election.…

image.caption: Germany's coalition government aims to soften the impact of soaring energy prices on householdsImage: SUSANNAH IRELAND/AFP/Getty Images

blocks.text: The coalition government has agreed on an electricity tax cut for households amid energy shocks from the war in Iran. Meanwhile, the BSW party has failed to push for a recount of the 2025 election. DW has more.
